description: Help content linked to a field, component or route of the user interface. The help panel shows tenant content first, then application content, then the field description.

fields.description: Short name of the help topic. Shown as the heading in the help panel.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Publishing state. Only published topics are shown to users. A topic is written as a draft, reviewed and then published.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Who provides the content. Tenant content comes first, then application content. Help on a custom field must be tenant content.
fields.label: Layer

fields.description: User responsible for this content. Standard fields belong to the application team, custom fields to the tenant administrator.
fields.label: Content Owner

fields.description: What the topic explains: a field of a document type, a user interface component or a route.
fields.label: Target Type

fields.description: Document type of the field. Required when the target type is Field.
fields.label: Document Type

fields.description: Field name in the document type, custom fields included. Required when the target type is Field.
fields.label: Field Name

fields.description: Identifier of the user interface component. Required when the target type is Component.
fields.label: Component ID

fields.description: Route the topic applies to, for example /app/sales-invoice. Required when the target type is Route.
fields.label: Route Pattern

fields.description: Application that owns the target. For a field it is filled from the document type when the topic is saved.
fields.label: App

fields.description: Language of the content. Leave empty to show the topic in every language.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Application version the content applies to. Leave empty to show the topic in every version.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Roles that see the topic. Leave empty to show the topic to every role.
fields.label: Target Roles

fields.description: Help text in plain text. Do not write record data, personal data or secrets here.
fields.label: Content

fields.description: Optional HTTPS URL or same-site relative path. Leave blank when unavailable.
fields.label: Tour URL

fields.description: Optional HTTPS URL or same-site relative path. Leave blank when unavailable.
fields.label: Documentation URL

fields.description: Optional HTTPS URL or same-site relative path. Leave blank when unavailable.
fields.label: Support URL

name: PLT Help Topic
